news.title: Hypercall to launch first Anthropic-linked pre-IPO options market
news.summary: Trading is expected to begin Monday, with calls, puts and more complex strategies available in select non-US jurisdictions.

news.title: Crypto ETFs see over half a billion dollars in outflows amid post-midterm market slide
news.summary: U.S. spot crypto ETFs slumped back to net outflows on Thursday, with more than $540 million in withdrawals across major products.

news.title: Over $1 billion in bullish bets liquidated while ETF flows suggest no help in spot market
news.summary: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 6, 2026

news.title: Solana’s Shanghai event halted over unauthorized promotion: Report
news.summary: Solana’s promotional campaigns through domestic entities allegedly violated China’s crypto-related restrictions, an unidentified PBOC official told China’s Financial News.

news.title: Live updates: Bitcoin holding $76,000, Nasdaq bounces ahead of U.S. jobs data
news.summary: Nasdaq 100 futures were higher by 1.5% following Thursday's 5.5% rout. Japan's Nikkei and Korea's Kospi each slumped 6% overnight.

news.title: Bitcoin steadies after AI-led selloff as eyes turn to latest U.S. jobs figures
news.summary: Bitcoin bounced from around $75,200 after Thursday’s AI-led selloff, which drove more than $1 billion in liquidations, as traders await the U.S. jobs report.

news.title: Nigeria’s central bank introduces stablecoin licensing rules, bans algorithmic versions
news.summary: Nigeria's central bank issued new virtual asset regulations requiring stablecoin issuers and other service providers to obtain local licenses.

news.title: Binance hackers had 8 weeks of access before $6.3B exploit, Security Alliance estimates
news.summary: The cybersecurity company flagged similar multi-stage intrusion patterns behind other high-profile crypto heists, including the $388 million Bitget hack.

news.title: Bitcoin holds $75K as AI regulation fears see KOSPI halted after 8% crash
news.summary: Bitcoin consolidated as fears over US AI regulation spread to Asia, causing South Korea to announce measures to calm stock-market volatility.

news.title: Greece approves 10% tax on crypto gains starting in 2027
news.summary: Greece has approved a 10% tax on cryptocurrency gains starting in 2027, with an exemption for investors whose annual net gains do not exceed 500 euros.

news.title: GOPAX halts crypto trading, withdrawals to move all assets to cold storage
news.summary: South Korea’s GOPAX suspended trading, deposits and standard withdrawals after a hacking threat, with manual withdrawals available through support.

news.title: Binance’s $6.3B hack leaves questions over hot wallet safeguards
news.summary: Experts say blockchain records show repeated wallet drains but cannot establish Binance’s internal signing controls or transaction limits.

news.title: Bitcoin recovers $76,000 level as ETFs shed $430 million after tech rout
news.summary: Bitcoin recovered above $76,000 Friday after dropping below that level during Thursday's tech-driven market rout.

news.title: Zcash NU7 upgrade goes live, leaves 12,224 ZEC stranded in Sprout pool
news.summary: Zcash’s NU7 upgrade has rendered about $15 million in legacy Sprout funds unspendable, although a future network upgrade could potentially restore access.

news.title: Greece approves 10% tax on crypto gains and 15% levy on DeFi income
news.summary: Investors will have 12 months to declare past crypto gains without late-filing penalties, though questions remain over crypto-to-crypto swaps.

news.title: Hyperliquid Strategies seeks futures registration for perps
news.summary: The HYPE treasury company spent $785 million on tokens during the quarter and wants to bring Hyperliquid-based perpetual futures to the US.

news.title: Kalshi hit with injunction over sports contracts on California tribal lands
news.summary: A federal judge has granted the preliminary injunction to bar Kalshi from offering sports contracts on the lands of two California tribes.

news.title: Bitcoin, Ether ETFs post $530M outflows as election gains evaporate
news.summary: US spot Bitcoin and Ether ETFs shed a combined $530 million Thursday as Bitcoin fell below $76,000 and US stocks tumbled.

news.title: Trump-backed World Liberty Financial plans token buyback after 66% year-to-date slide
news.summary: The crypto venture may use fees from its USD1 stablecoin reserves to fund token purchases as it seeks to boost governance.

news.title: Zcash’s major network upgrade NU7 goes live on mainnet, cutting block time by threefold
news.summary: NU7 also activates the Network Sustainability Mechanism, which removes 60% of each block's transaction fees from circulation.

news.title: Chainalysis says breach exposed password hashes and live tokens
news.summary: Chainalysis disclosed password hashes and live tokens were exposed after initially reporting only non-sensitive customer data was accessed.

news.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
news.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

news.title: Zcash’s landmark NU7 upgrade goes live, speeding up private payments
news.summary: NU7 cuts the target time between blocks to 25 seconds, reduces the work wallets must do to find private payments and sets aside fees for future miners.

news.title: Crypto exchanges tout cold storage ratios after Binance attack
news.summary: Coinbase says it keeps more than 99% of customer assets offline, while Gate reports 88.26% of its total assets are kept in cold storage.

news.title: IREN’s bitcoin mining revenue drops 58% as firm plans full exit by year-end
news.summary: IREN has been shifting its focus to the AI infrastructure business, and its AI cloud revenue rose 182% in the past quarter to $200 million.

news.title: Ark Invest buys more Coinbase as shares plunge 10% in wider market rout
news.summary: Cathie Wood's Ark Invest bought $2.44 million worth of Coinbase on Thursday as the stock plunged 9.69% amid a broader sell-off.

news.title: Hyperliquid treasury firm seeking U.S. regulatory nod as a domestic futures platform
news.summary: The company said it's trying to establish a U.S. "futures commission merchant" with full compliance for activity with U.S. clients, though the timing is uncertain.

news.title: Bitcoin developer proposes ‘landmines’ to make quantum thieves lose their own BTC
news.summary: Anyone trying to move vulnerable bitcoin would have to put up matching collateral, giving prepared owners a chance to take both.

news.title: Core Scientific to quit Bitcoin mining by year-end as AI business surges
news.summary: The former Bitcoin mining heavyweight plans to become a pure-play data center provider in 2027, with mining now accounting for just 7.5% of quarterly revenue.

news.title: American Bitcoin’s $126M profit masks mining pressure as rivals turn to AI
news.summary: The Eric Trump-backed miner reported $126 million in quarterly net income, largely driven by gains on its Bitcoin holdings, despite rising mining costs and shrinking margins.

news.title: Asian crypto exchanges batten down the hatches as hacks surge: Asia Express
news.summary: Asian crypto exchanges are scrambling to tighten security on fears of a wave of potentially AI-assisted hacks, even as regional governments embrace tokenization and stablecoins.

news.title: Hyperliquid Strategies files to become CFTC-registered FCM, posts $13.3 million in quaterly revenue
news.summary: Hyperliquid Strategies posted $13.3M in revenue and $620.6M net income, and filed with the CFTC to become an FCM for U.S. HIP-3 perp markets.

news.title: Crypto ally French Hill wins reelection but set to lose House chair
news.summary: Republican French Hill secured another term in Congress but will lose his leadership of the House Financial Services Committee when Democrats take control in January.

news.title: Bitcoin erases post-election gains as Wall Street selloff triggers over $1 billion in crypto liquidations
news.summary: Bitcoin fell 6% to $75,700 and ether 7% as a Nasdaq selloff hit crypto, triggering $1.03 billion in liquidations.

news.title: Binance, Deribit revoke SignalPlus API keys after fake Teams invite attack
news.summary: SignalPlus said attackers compromised an engineer’s computer in a breach that resulted in losses of less than $82,000, which the crypto trading platform pledged to reimburse in full.

news.title: Base deploys Denim upgrade on mainnet, replacing Flashblocks with 200ms block times
news.summary: Base activated its fourth network upgrade, Denim, introducing five canonical blocks per second at 200ms intervals.

news.title: U.S. Justice Department assembles force to shield against foreign AI threats
news.summary: The new DOJ task force will aid the recently designated U.S. "SI Force" by warding off bad actors backed by other nations, criminal groups or corporate fraud.

news.title: Bitcoin tumbles to $76,000 as collapsing AI trade drags stocks sharply lower
news.summary: The post-election rally quickly reversed as AI stocks plunged, but cryptocurrencies held up relatively better despite a $1 billion liquidation wave.

news.title: Fed, OCC check US banks after Binance hack as experts flag security risks
news.summary: US regulators reportedly contacted banks following last week’s $6.3 billion Binance security hack, while experts raised concerns about transaction security and crypto risks.

news.title: Europe’s largest asset manager Amundi tokenizes equity index fund on Ethereum
news.summary: The new share class offers blockchain-based exposure to an index tracking 600 companies across European markets.

news.title: Paraguay president resigns after collapse of Ueno digital bank
news.summary: Santiago Peña stepped down amid mounting scrutiny over his former ties to Ueno Bank’s parent company, as the lender’s collapse left millions of customers unable to access their funds.

news.title: What is TraderTraitor, the hacking squad behind the $6.3 billion Binance heist?
news.summary: The hacking group has been behind some of the crypto industry's most recent high-profile thefts.

news.title: Canary’s Injective ETF debuts on Nasdaq with exposure to staking rewards
news.summary: Canary Capital's Staked INJ ETF debuts on Nasdaq, giving investors exposure to Injective's INJ token plus staking rewards reflected in NAV.

news.title: Standard Chartered and SBI back crypto insurer Soter as funding reaches $23.5 million
news.summary: Soter also received backing of 500 BTC and 2000 ETH, worth another $43 million at current prices.

news.title: Bitcoin crashes 6% to 7-week low as US stocks erase election gains
news.summary: Bitcoin saw sudden downside at the Wall Street open as stocks witnessed a snap sell-off, reversing post-election gains.

news.title: Crypto for Advisors: Where investors stake crypto shapes how much of the reward they keep
Anchorage Digital seeks CFTC swap dealer registration for crypto options business
news.summary: Anchorage Digital has applied for CFTC swap dealer registration and plans to offer European-style bitcoin and ether options if approved.

news.title: Payward-affiliated fund and clients buy AAVE token stake on secondary market
news.summary: Payward disclosed neither the size nor price of the AAVE purchases and said it may acquire more tokens.

news.title: Gate CEO says crypto exchanges must prove they can survive a hack like Binance’s
news.summary: Lin Han says Gate holds enough assets in cold storage to cover customer balances even if its hot wallets are emptied. An independent audit is underway.

news.title: Samsung Wallet launches USDC accounts on Solana for US Galaxy users
news.summary: Samsung Wallet's Stablecoin Account is now live for eligible U.S. Galaxy users, allowing them to use USDC on Solana.

news.title: Kraken parent Payward and its clients buy AAVE tokens in DeFi investment push
news.summary: The investment follows talks first reported by CoinDesk in June that included a proposed equity stake in Aave Group.

news.title: Blockchain is ‘perfect solution’ for AI agent trust, VeChain CEO says
news.summary: Sunny Lu said AI agents would need identity and reputation systems, making the case while promoting agent-building platform VeWorld.ai.

news.title: Can decentralized phone networks power the AI revolution?
news.summary: Decentralized AI networks want to turn everyday phones into an alternative to centralized computing infrastructure — but skeptics have their doubts.

news.title: Google could take stake in bitcoin miner TeraWulf’s $19 billion AI project if Anthropic defaults
news.summary: A $19 billion data-center agreement includes an unusual provision allowing Google to acquire part of the project if Anthropic fails to pay its rent.

news.title: Binance cuts SignalPlus access after security warning, urges users to check accounts
news.summary: The exchange says its systems are unaffected but has removed trading connections to the third-party platform as a precaution.

news.title: Ukraine’s central bank opposes crypto bill, citing monetary sovereignty concerns
news.summary: Ukraine’s central bank won’t back a crypto legalization bill in its current form and wants lawmakers to revise it before a final vote.

news.title: Trump’s memecoin ventures derailed CLARITY Act, Scaramucci says
news.summary: The SkyBridge founder said disputes over ethics restrictions also stalled negotiations, with both sides responsible for the setback.

news.title: Bitcoin is resilient, but leverage is missing and demand still tepid
news.summary: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 5, 2026

news.title: Bitcoin miners are oversold following 35% October rout, VanEck says
news.summary: Investors dumped AI infrastructure providers across the board in October, treating companies in very different sectors as one monolithic trade.

news.title: Trump-linked American Bitcoin swings to $126 million profit but misses revenue estimates
news.summary: Revenue fell to $63.4 million in the third quarter and missed analysts’ forecasts as bitcoin production declined and higher summer electricity prices pushed mining costs up.

news.title: Thailand to block Bitget in December over unlicensed crypto trading
news.summary: Thailand’s SEC filed a criminal complaint against Bitget’s operator, with access to its website and app set to be blocked from Dec. 5.

news.title: Bitcoin holds above $80,000 after Wednesday’s jump as injective rallies on staked ETF listing
news.summary: Bitcoin slipped 0.2% to around $80,250 since midnight UTC, holding above $80,000 after Wednesday’s jump, as spot ETFs ended a three-day outflow streak.

news.title: Live updates: Bitcoin drops more than 5% as stocks close out worst day since April 2025
news.summary: The continued blowup of the AI trade led markets lower, with Nvidia losing 9.3% and many other chip names down double-digit percentages.

news.title: Mercado Bitcoin hack continued hours after exchange said attack was contained, report finds
news.summary: The same attacker took about $391,000, mostly from wallets Bitquery ties to BitMart, whose founder confirmed a Nov. 2 hack and suspects a link.

news.title: Eric Trump’s American Bitcoin swings to $126 million profit in Q3 on digital asset gains
news.summary: American Bitcoin reported Q3 net income of $126 million, swinging from a $57.2 million net loss in the previous quarter.

news.title: Arkansas sues Kalshi, says its alleged illegal gambling operations cause mental harm
news.summary: The lawsuit adds Arkansas to a growing list of states taking legal action against the prediction market platform.

news.title: The Digital Chamber calls Sherrod Brown’s win ‘most consequential unfavorable result’ for crypto
news.summary: Democrats are set to reorient the crypto policy debate toward stronger consumer protections and regulatory accountability, the group said.

news.title: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa confirms cyberattack after ZachXBT flags $133M in suspected losses
news.summary: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa did not confirm the exact amount of losses but validated the order of magnitude of the $133 million figure.

news.title: Democratic sweep of Congress forces crypto industry to rethink Washington strategy
news.summary: After two years of a pro-crypto, pro-innovation climate in Washington, the digital asset industry faces a sharp political jolt.

news.title: Bitcoin rebounds past $80,000 as markets shrug off midterms and Binance hack
news.summary: Bitcoin rose 3.5% to $80,500 and ether jumped 6% after Democrats won Congress, while Bitwise says the Binance hack had limited market impact.
